title: External clients fail TLS, internals look fine
query: External clients fail the TLS handshake but internal health checks are green and the gateway error rate is flat.
root_cause: The TLS certificate on the public edge has expired.

remediation.detail: Install a new certificate and reload the proxy.

evidence: Internal health checks and metrics are normal
The certificate expiry date has passed
query_paraphrase: Outside customers can't establish a secure connection, though our internal health checks are green and the gateway error graph hasn't moved.
